subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw ship `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a public after-compaction plugin contract with current-session-only, deferred, best-effort semantics?
rationale: This adds a compatibility-sensitive plugin capability and session-lifecycle policy; code review can verify mechanics but cannot decide whether this permanent contract belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor the narrowed API
options.body: Approve the after-compaction-only contract, require the leaf-module fix and real reset proof, then land it with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep reset host-owned
options.body: Reject a hook-context reset primitive and require context-engine or host policy to request session replacement through another owner-controlled seam.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it until a core use case and contract owner are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrowed API
recommendation.body: Approve the after-compaction-only contract, require the leaf-module fix and real reset proof, then land it with focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of the gateway session-reset lifecycle that defines this capability's safety boundary.
